commentary: While benchmark indices staged a sharp relief bounce propelled by crude cooling below $100/bbl, market breadth remains fragile with a breadth score of 36 keeping our gate deterministic at WEAK. In Stan Weinstein and William O'Neil tradition, index rallies on narrow or nascent breadth in a tentative tape must be treated as suspect rallies, not all-clear signals. Institutional distribution remains overhead, and key moving averages across broader market composites are still flattening. Legendary discipline dictates holding back aggressive capital, maintaining defensive cash, and restricting exploratory exposure strictly to elite Stage 2 leaders displaying unshakeable CANSLIM earnings acceleration and tight VCP pivots.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM, Weinstein Stage Analysis, Darvas Box & Livermore Discipline

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Constructing a double-bottom base within a larger 26.6% cup-with-handle pattern. Price holds above the rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA, with handle volume contracting constructively and RSI at 68. However, lighter institutional sponsorship and lower liquidity demand caution on breakout attempts.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Severe top-line contraction in Q1 FY27 with revenue plunging 55% YoY and net profit tumbling 25% YoY to ₹1.02 Cr. Operating margins remain thin at 2-3%, and ROCE fails CANSLIM leadership hurdles, making this an erratic fundamental profile.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: A close below the handle low at 99.56 invalidates the pivot structure; immediately execute stop discipline to avoid Stage 3 rolling risk.

ACE.technical: Textbook Stage 2 leader rebounding off its rising 21-EMA and 50-SMA. Carving an orderly double bottom with neckline resistance near 1,269.27. Strong bullish accumulation candle reclaimed recent selling, and RSI at 71 reflects persistent leadership momentum without severe extension.
ACE.fundamental: Robust market leader in pick-and-carry cranes. Net profit accelerated 22% YoY in Q1 FY27 on 19% top-line growth. Balance sheet is pristine with zero net debt, healthy ROCE exceeding 31%, ROE near 23%, and strong unpledged promoter backing.
ACE.risk: Breaching the 1,184.07 swing pivot violates 50-SMA support, warranting an immediate defensive exit.

ADFFOODS.technical: Tightening within 1.5% of its 20-session pivot at 331.08. Price sits comfortably above the rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA. Volume rose to 1.38× the 20-day average on recent accumulation, with RSI at 60 showing quiet, constructive base buildup.
ADFFOODS.fundamental: Revenue growth was robust at +26% YoY in Q1 FY27, but bottom-line growth decelerated sharply to +13% YoY from +58% in Q4 FY26. Balance sheet is virtually debt-free with solid ROCE near 22%, but earnings deceleration limits CANSLIM leadership status.
ADFFOODS.risk: A drop below 309.43 violates the base consolidation floor and requires immediate loss cutting.

AEROFLEX.technical: Dynamic Stage 2 performer riding powerful relative strength. Pulled back calmly to test the rising 21-EMA near record highs before rebounding on heavy 1.8× average volume. Completing a clean double bottom pivot at 584.73 with dry-up characteristics.
AEROFLEX.fundamental: Pure CANSLIM profile. Q1 FY27 revenue expanded 72% YoY to ₹146 Cr, while net profit soared 162% YoY to ₹18.8 Cr. Operating margins remain firm around 20-23%, accompanied by negligible debt and zero promoter pledging.
AEROFLEX.risk: Thesis fails if price slips below the 525.74 swing shelf, demanding quick capital preservation.

APARINDS.technical: High-tier Stage 2 institutional compounder. Found precise support at the rising 21-EMA and formed an orderly double bottom base with neckline pressure at 19,284.26. RSI at 54 indicates ample runway, while relative strength vs. broader indices remains elite.
APARINDS.fundamental: Dominant global player in power conductors and cables. Q1 FY27 net profit accelerated 78% YoY to ₹467 Cr on 29% revenue growth, backed by high-margin export demand. Delivers superior return metrics (ROCE ~32%) and a massive net-cash balance sheet.
APARINDS.risk: A breakdown below 17,506.69 pierces intermediate moving average support and triggers a non-negotiable stop.

ARSSBL.technical: Stage 2 post-IPO base breakout. Decisively cleared a 20-session resistance pivot at 593.19 on surging institutional volume reaching 2.16× average. Price trends cleanly above all moving averages, and RSI at 71 confirms high-velocity momentum.
ARSSBL.fundamental: Capital markets play exhibiting accelerating fundamentals. Q1 FY27 net profit jumped 71% YoY to ₹23.4 Cr on 22% top-line expansion. Sustains healthy ROCE of 19.8%, clean 67% promoter ownership, and steady fee income expansion across broking and distribution.
ARSSBL.risk: A reversal below the breakout pivot low of 555.55 breaks momentum and necessitates immediate risk cut.
